name: [UPD 6.5] Anime Card Clash
desc:
Anime Card Clash ⛩️

[UPDATE 9.1 POWER DUNGEON]

Grind your way through the immersive Story maps, play Infinite Towers and Nightmare Modes, or PVP for the top ranking on leaderboards. Secret Boss Raids and Battle Towers are waiting for you!

[How to Play]
🎲 • ROLL button to start rolling cards! (tip: use auto roll and quick roll)
🌀 • DECK button to build your deck! 
🌐 • TELEPORT to start the story mode! 
🍀 • UPGRADES to upgrade your Luck, Cooldown, Boss Chance, and more!
🔥 • BATTLE bosses, crush the Battle Tower, or PVP to gain rankings!

PC, Mobile, Console supported. Premium players receive Luck and Cooldown bonuses!
